name: tristimulator-thirdparty
description: Third-party C++ image-processing libraries for Tristimulator. Built statically and linked directly into the app binary. Movies are handled by AVFoundation; JPEG/PNG/TIFF/HEIF by macOS ImageIO. OIIO retains the formats it is uniquely good at (OpenEXR, JPEG XL, JPEG 2000, WebP). Camera RAW is not linked; LibRaw is not a dependency.
